title: 第6章 日期-《我发现了世界BUG》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “我爸走之前给我们留了信，交代我们等你。”

    “他说你肯定会来，就是不知道早晚。”

    “本来我们想着你再快也得明天来，但今天接我爸回来以后，我就有种预感，总觉得你应该快到了，所以就去村口等着了。”

    “没想到还真等到了......其实我连你长啥样都不知道，反正看到生人就问一嘴.......”

    徐峰的语气轻快，父亲走了，他似乎并没有多大的悲伤。

    其实这也正常----华夏农村的葬礼一贯都是这样的。

    孝子贤孙在棺材前多少都要哭几声，但离了灵堂，大多都是能够谈笑风生的。

    不是因为他们心里没苦，是因为这个家还得他们撑着。

    越是生死大事，就越不能倒、越不能露怯。

    所以，林舒也并不觉得徐峰的表现有什么反常。

    他只是一边跟着徐峰往村里走，一边应和道：

    “可能是徐师公在天之灵保佑吧。”

    “嗨，哪有那么玄乎。”

    徐峰满不在乎地摆手道：

    “说出来你可能不信，我爸是不信什么转世轮回啦、阴曹地府啦那一套的。”

    “他以前总跟我们说，人死了就是死了，意识消散了，在这个世界就不存在了。”

    “所以，如果他哪天死了，也不需要大办特办，尤其师公过世那一套流程绝对不要走，劳民伤财。”

    “但是吧......”

    徐峰稍稍放慢脚步，脸转向林舒说道：

    “但是你也知道，葬礼很多时候其实是办给活人看的。”

    “反正他活着的时候也没有强烈反对，死了留下信也没提，那我们就还是按师公升天的标准给他办了。”

    “喏，今天来了七个师公，都是来给他送山、压棺的。”

    “压棺？”

    林舒不解问道：

    “是什么意思？”

    徐峰带着林舒转进一条小巷，绕过拥挤的人群，随口回答道：

    “就是要坐在棺材上送他出山----出殡。”

    “一般来说，是表示衣钵有人传承，不至于让他死不瞑目成了邪祟。”

    “反正就那么回事吧，我不信这个，就单纯走个流程而已。”

    徐峰的语气里透露出几分淡然----是淡然，但不是鄙夷。

    他虽然尊重父亲，但好像真的一点都不信“师公”这一套，这跟林舒预想的完全相反。

    在来之前，他还以为徐长顺一家都是梅山派的忠实信徒来着。

    现在看起来，至少徐峰根本不是。

    徐长顺这个人，真是越来越复杂了......

    走过小巷，两人来到了一个青砖黛瓦的合院中，大门敞开着，许多前来上志的人被挡在了门口，而林舒、徐峰两人则是直接从侧门进入，跨过二门，进入了堂屋。

    在那里，一口黑沉沉的棺材静静停在灵床上。

    棺材前烧着香、摆着火盆。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"My dad left us a letter before he left, telling us that we would be waiting for you."

"He said you will definitely come, but I don't know whether it will be sooner or later."

"Originally, we thought that you would come tomorrow no matter how soon, but after picking up my dad today, I had a hunch that you should be arriving soon, so I went to the entrance of the village and waited."

"I didn't expect that I would wait until this time...Actually, I don't even know what you look like. Anyway, I just ask strangers when I see them..."

Xu Feng's tone was brisk. He didn't seem to be very sad when his father left.

In fact, this is normal - funerals in rural China have always been like this.

Filial sons and grandsons will cry a few times in front of the coffin, but after leaving the mourning hall, most of them can talk and laugh.

“It’s not because they don’t feel miserable, it’s because they still have to support this family.

The more serious the matter of life and death, the less likely you are to fail and the less likely you are to show your cowardice.

Therefore, Lin Shu didn’t think there was anything abnormal about Xu Feng’s performance.

He just followed Xu Feng towards the village and said in agreement:

“Maybe it’s Master Xu’s spirit in heaven who is blessing me.”

"Hey, it's not that mysterious."

Xu Feng waved his hands nonchalantly and said:

"You may not believe it, but my dad doesn't believe in reincarnation or the underworld."

"He always told us before that when a person dies, he is dead. When his consciousness dissipates, he ceases to exist in this world."

"So, if he dies one day, there is no need to make any special arrangements. Especially when the master passes away, you must not go through the set of procedures, which will waste people and money."

"But..."

Xu Feng slowed down slightly, turned to Lin Shu and said:

"But you also know that funerals are often held for living people."

"Anyway, he didn't have any strong objections when he was alive, and he didn't even mention it in the letter after he died, so we'll let him do it according to the standard of master's ascension to heaven."

"Well, there are seven masters here today, all here to deliver the coffin to him."

"Coffin pressure?"

Lin Shu asked in confusion:

"What does it mean?"

Xu Feng led Lin Shu into an alley, bypassed the crowded crowd, and replied casually:

"I just want to sit on the coffin and send him out - the funeral."

"Generally speaking, it means that someone has inherited the mantle and will not let him die with his eyes open and become an evil spirit."

“That’s it anyway, I don’t believe this, I’m just going through the process.”

Xu Feng's tone revealed a bit of indifference - indifferent, but not disdain.

Although he respects his father, he really doesn't seem to believe in the "master" thing at all, which is completely contrary to Lin Shu's expectation.

Before coming here, he thought that Xu Changshun and his family were loyal followers of the Meishan Sect.

Now it seems that at least Xu Feng is not at all.

Xu Changshun is getting more and more complicated...

Walking through the alley, the two came to a courtyard with blue bricks and black tiles. The door was open, and many people who came to Shangzhi were blocked at the door. Lin Shu and Xu Feng entered directly from the side door, crossed the second door, and entered the main room.

There, a dark coffin rested quietly on the funeral bed.

Incense was burning and a brazier was placed in front of the coffin.
